checks.message: Two to four uniquely named conditions (letters, digits, _ . + -; up to 48 characters).
One to five uniquely named numeric metrics.
Two to four competing explanations with unique ids.
Three to twelve distinct non-negative integer seeds, shared by every condition.
At most 60 measure() calls (conditions x seeds).
Each explanation commits one to four expected outcomes, each comparing two declared conditions on a declared metric with a non-negative tolerance.
The explanations must expect different outcomes; otherwise the experiment cannot tell them apart.
Commit which explanation you expect the measurements to support.
Define measure(condition, seed) at the top level.
measure() must change behaviour based on the condition.
measure() must use the seed so every condition is paired and repeatable.
No network, process, serialisation or interpreter-control modules.
No eval/exec, file deletion, writes outside scratch, or interpreter internals.
The harness must import or load the uploaded Python code (for example with counterlab_sandbox.load('path/to/file.py')), so the experiment tests what was uploaded.
